dict.string: Freenpipe uses the microphone to record and transcribe audio on this Mac.
Freenpipe needs screen recording access to capture what is on your screen.
Freenpipe needs screen recording access to capture what is on your screen.
Freenpipe captures system audio through a CoreAudio process tap and transcribes it on this Mac. To leave an app out, add its bundle ID to ~/.screenpipe/audio-exclusions.json.
Freenpipe needs system extension access to capture audio output.
Freenpipe adds the action items it finds in your screen and audio activity to Apple Reminders.
Freenpipe reads your calendar to recognise meetings. Calendar data never leaves this Mac.
